name: Barbaridactylus
sum: One of the largest nyctosaurids, from the latest Cretaceous (Maastrichtian) phosphates of Morocco.
wsnote: About 4 m wingspan and 4 kg body mass.
holotype: FSAC-OB 232 — Couche III, Ouled Abdoun Basin, Morocco.
material: Right femur, left radius, ulna, humerus, scapulocoracoid and partial mandible; four referred specimens.
biology: Lived over a rich marine ecosystem with sharks, mosasaurs and plesiosaurs; nyctosaurids were ocean-going soarers with upturned jaws.
author: Longrich et al. 2018
